status: first concrete empirical scale-map candidate with locked dictionary and no-refit rules

scale_levels.M1: dimensionless physical predictions with fixed scale/scheme/RG prescription

required_dimensionful_anchors: one energy/mass/length anchor fixing the remaining unit scale
no_refit_rules: After anchors and RG/continuum rules are fixed, no observable-specific refitting is allowed.
Dimensionless ratios must be tested before dimensionful absolute quantities.
Every fitted anchor consumes one degree of freedom and must be listed separately from predictions.
The RG or continuum rule must be specified before comparing with data.
Each empirical claim must include measurement uncertainty and theory uncertainty.
theorem_statement: Scale Map v1 turns the W33 finite theorem into an empirical framework by separating no-scale finite predictions, dimensionless physical predictions, and dimensionful predictions. It locks an observable dictionary and no-refit rules: after anchors, schemes, and RG/continuum flow are fixed, all residuals must be evaluated without moving the map.
honesty_boundary: This is a candidate empirical dictionary, not a completed data fit. It defines what must be compared and how it can fail. Measured constants should be supplied by a separate versioned data file before numerical residuals are claimed.
